summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) initialized in __init__, set and cleared in the run_app entry coroutine's try/finally, and new tests in tests/test_call_from_thread.py. Ran with PYTHONPATH=<repo>/src because the venv's textual points at another checkout. Results: 9 of 10 new tests passed on the first run; the timeout-propagation test had a bug in my test (str() of a two-argument exception is a tuple repr), which I fixed to a one-argument exception. After the fix, the new module plus test_auto_pilot.py and test_loop.py passed (14 total). tests/test_unmount.py fails because its async test is not supported in this environment, which is unrelated to this change. Nothing committed. The new module has not been re-run in full since the last test edit, so the timeout test's fix is verified only through the combined run that passed.
